title: Scouting report 1: residuals against everything
body: A residuals-vs-fitted plot can look fine while a residuals-vs-predictor plot does not. Plot your residuals against every column in the codebook, including the ones that are not in your model, and add a smooth curve (geom_smooth()).
A bend says the form of a predictor is wrong. A trend in a predictor you left out says it belongs in the model. A flat cloud says that column has nothing more to tell you.

title: Scouting report 3: when a straight line is not enough
body: If a residual plot from Report 2 bends, a spline in that predictor is one line of code: splines::ns(x, df = 3) inside lm(). It is still a linear model.
Before you keep it, ask whether the bend is real: compare the models with a nested F-test (anova(smaller, bigger)), and check that the training improvement survives on the leaderboard.
